roads.name: Oatman Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 100 in 8.0 miles, about 12 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 2,678 to 3,597 ft, with 2,430 ft of up and down along the way.
8 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 100°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 20 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.19 g.
